item.title: Dakin Receives MAC Grant
item.description: Dakin Humane Society is a 2019 recipient of a Massachusetts Animal Coalition’s (MAC) “I’m Animal Friendly” license plate grant. The grant will support low-cost spay and neuter services offered at Dakin’s Community Spay/Neuter Clinic, the largest in New England. Dakin is one of several Massachusetts spay/neuter programs to receive a 2019 “I’m Animal Friendly” license plate grant, and will use the funds to spay/neuter owned and free-roaming cats in Massachusetts. item.title: Dakin's Amazon Wish List
item.description: You can help animals and shop from the comfort of your home! Check out our Amazon Wish List (When you buy through Amazon Smile, you can designate Dakin Humane Society for a portion of the proceeds!). We keep it stocked with all sorts of supplies we need, and you can have it shipped directly to our door! Thank you from them...and from us!
